variants.title: 종이에 그린 낮잠
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, stylized-concept. Asset: one polished portrait mobile survival action game concept screenshot, approximately 9:19 ratio, flat full-bleed screen with no phone hardware or surrounding marketing page. Input image is a reference for scene contents, camera and CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. Completely replace the rejected HUD construction; do not copy its frame, pillars, bevels, pills or borders. Preserve the tiny cute girl: chestnut wavy hair, small dusty-pink ribbon, large rounded head, dot eyes, rosy cheeks, mint dress, very short limbs; same head/body proportions and small gameplay scale. Familiar-but-strange dream world: pale mint clearing, one oversized chair, a freestanding open dusty-pink door to a different sky, a handful of round dark-green friendly-scary shadow creatures, paper-shaped projectiles and a subtle rust attack warning. Three-quarter overhead arena view, full playing field visible and girl near center. Real gameplay HUD, mobile-first: pause symbol top left with an approximately 48px comfortable touch area, large survival timer exactly "03:24" independently centered at top, compact top-right cute shadow-creature icon and "128" below small Korean label "처치". All HUD glyphs and text have clean dark/light contrast and generous breathing room inside safe margins. Small HP bar immediately under girl, exact text "72 / 100". Type: cute rounded Korean display lettering like Jua for timer, clean rounded Korean UI sans like Pretendard for small text. Do not add other labels, title, currency, XP, level, inventory, action buttons, tutorial text, preview badges, phone status bar or bottom text. Low visual noise; enough active combat readability. HUD and environment MUST look authored together in exactly the same medium, line weight, lighting and palette. No conventional website UI, no glass panels, no mechanical window architecture, no decorative corner posts, no added stars/hearts/ribbons simply to decorate the interface. Detail comes from coherent material and hand-authored shapes, not additional ornaments. This is a concept art exploration, not a screenshot of an existing commercial game. Direction A: LUNCHTIME GOUACHE DREAM. A warm illustrated picture-book gouache painting on subtly fibrous ivory paper. Desaturated sage and pistachio, blush clay, buttercream and charcoal olive. Simplified hand-painted silhouettes, slightly irregular confident warm-olive contours, chalky pigment pooling only at edges, small soft contact shadows. Repaint girl, chair, door, monsters AND UI in this same gouache style; never clean SVG UI on painted art. The HUD should feel like spare brush marks and printed illustration belonging to the same picture: a small left-edge dusty-rose painted tab containing two sturdy pause strokes, center timer dark-olive ink on a very subtle cream pigment wash merging into the pale sky, top-right icon/count drawn directly in ink without a closed card. No connected full-width frame. Tiny corner paper layering may appear only where it naturally defines the pause tab, not a scrapbook collage. Overall sunny and cute with subtly unsettling proportions, not sepia vintage, not generic farm UI. Match the original simple girl closely. Actual gameplay stage occupies at least 85% of screen.

HUD uses the same softly stuffed cloth medium: a small folded dusty-pink fabric tab comes from the left screen edge with two dark embroidered pause strokes; centered time is clean dark-green embroidered numbers on a slim cream cloth selvage that merges into a small soft edge fold, not a hanging plaque or chunky pillow; top-right shadow icon and count are clean dark stitched ink on a little cream fabric edge extension open to the right. Restrained sparse stitching belongs only at actual hems, no decorative bows, buttons or dangling threads. All 3 info zones leave large separation, no full-width decorated frame. Pale ivory/mint/blush only, melancholic nap mood, never candy saturated. Legible timer and HUD over tactile material.

Direction C: MOONLIT FAMILIAR CLEARING. A beautifully cohesive hand-painted 2D animation background and character style, dreamy slightly uneasy midnight garden. Smoky blue-green and desaturated deep teal with creamy moonlight and subdued rose door. Cute, NOT horror. Broad confident soft-edged color shapes, luminous pale mint pools of light, simple thin dark-teal character contours, no noisy texture, no bloom or sparkles. Giant chair and free-standing open pink door remain familiar silhouettes, their elongated shadows pointing oddly. Girl remains chestnut haired mint-dressed with dot eyes, warmly moonlit and readable against darker ground, not an elaborate princess portrait. Upper sky/background is naturally dark enough to support UI. The HUD takes the visual language of the scene's pale moonlit painted edges: at top left, a compact rose edge tab with two creamy solid pause marks, shape like a single painted swatch, NO border/panel; large cream timer "03:24" painted directly into quiet upper negative space, top-right small cream shadow-creature icon, Korean "처치", "128", also directly on sky, no enclosed cards. A faint cloud/sky silhouette may softly recede behind the top info but never forms a literal cloud-shaped button. Glanceable, sparse and elegant yet round and cute, feels part of a real mobile action game. No starry decorative frame, gold filigree, fantasy crystals, ornamental plaques or glassmorphism.
